name: Abstract and colour
description: Colour studies, flattened shapes and landscapes on the way to abstraction, from Japanese design prints to early modern painting, chosen for their colour behind a dashboard.

works.alt_text: Yellow and pink houses on a hillside above a sloping golden field, painted in thick strokes of bright yellow, blue, green and red.
A stylised cream wave curling across a dark blue ground in front of a large silver moon.
Rounded New Mexico hills built from patches of pink, ochre and green under swirling white and blue clouds.
A watercolour of red and orange rocks along a deep blue sea, with a small lighthouse island under a streaky pink and blue sky.
A Tahitian shore in flat areas of deep green, violet and ochre, with a large tree, a thatched hut, fallen branches and a pale blue bay.
A colour woodcut of a pale dirt road curving between green fields and dark trees, with an orange sunset band on the horizon.
A riverside village with a church spire below striped hillside fields, painted in small dots of blue, pink, green and cream.
Bands of pale silver waves crossing a calm sand-coloured ground in a simple, almost abstract print.
A farmhouse among bare, interlacing trees reflected in still water, painted in soft pinks, oranges and greys.
A woodblock print of coral orange lilies on tall stems with long dark green leaves against a pale turquoise ground.
A watercolour of a lakeside town in a haze of gold and pale blue light, with mountains dissolving into mist.
A woodblock print of coral pink poppies with spiky blue-green leaves on a pale turquoise ground.
A colour lithograph of figures walking through a flowering green meadow under long streaks of blue cloud.
A cubist still life of a pear and two bananas on a white napkin and a round dark plate, broken into flat white, grey and ochre shapes.
A watercolour of a bright blue bay with a stone fort on rocks, and beachgoers with red and blue parasols on the sand in the foreground.
A bridge and the towers of Westminster dissolving into a hazy fog of pale yellow, lilac and green.
A colour woodcut of a white moon rising behind red rocks on a low sandbar, reflected in calm violet-grey water.
A Tahitian garden of tall pale tree trunks, broad leaves and thatched huts, with figures resting on the green grass in bright, flat colour.
A colour print of a pine-framed cove with pink rocks, small sailing boats on pale green water and islands under soft clouds.
A village landscape broken into bold blocks of red, blue, green and yellow, with two tall poplar trees.
A pale colour lithograph of a harbour at evening, with a pier, a lighthouse tower and sailing boats drawn in small dabs of blue and yellow.
A bustling Paris café interior glowing with pink and gold light, with white tables and bentwood chairs in the foreground.
A watercolour of pollarded willows and bare trees along a still canal, with boats moored and a distant city skyline.
A colour print of green, moss-covered cliffs above a pale foaming sea, with a herder and animals grazing on the clifftop.
